test_title: PYST 12: SSC MTS 2024 - Numerical and Mathematical Ability (Held On: 14 Oct, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹3500 as a sum borrowed at 6% per year rate of interest for 3 years.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹3500

Rate of Interest (R) = 6% per year

Time (T) = 3 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) / 100

**Calculation:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (3500 × 6 × 3) / 100

⇒ SI = 630

**The simple interest on ₹3500 at 6% per year for 3 years is ₹630.**
